'''Amadaine 16 (June 24)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - [[Rand al'Thor|Rand's]] party reaches [[Tremonsien]] and he sees the statue of the male ''[[sa'angreal]]''.
* [[998 NE]] - [[Moiraine]] is attacked at [[Tifan's Well]].
* [[998 NE]] - [[Nynaeve]] is tested and raised to the [[Accepted]] and [[Egwene]] becomes a [[novice]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Siuan Sanche]] is deposed and stilled along with her [[Keeper of the Chronicles]], [[Leane Sharif]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] usurps the [[Amyrlin Seat]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Amathera Aelfdene Casmir Lounault]] is invested as [[Panarch]] of [[Tarabon]].
</noinclude>
